Rotaract Club of Navi Mumbai

Rotaract Club of Navi Mumbai with a proud legacy spanning 43 years, we are a community-based Rotaract club located in Vashi. As the oldest club in Zone 1, District 3142, we have played a pivotal role in spearheading the Rotaract movement in Navi Mumbai, fostering growth and development within our community and inspiring other Rotaract Clubs around us.

Thrust Areas of Rotaract Club of Navi Mumbai

Thrust Areas are the compass guiding us towards progress and innovation, propelling us forward on the path of excellence

LEADERSHIP GROWTH

We empower individuals to develop leadership skills through workshops, mentorship, and real-world experiences. Unleash your potential and lead with confidence.

EDUCATION

Our initiatives promote access to quality education for all, supporting skill development and raising awareness. Together, we build a more educated society.

ENVIRONMENT

Committed to sustainability, we organize eco-friendly initiatives like tree plantations and clean-up drives. Join us in protecting our planet for the future.

RESEARCH & INNOVATION

We encourage creative thinking and problem-solving, fostering innovation to drive societal progress. Explore new ideas and shape a brighter tomorrow.
